mapper.sql: (NVL(M.TEACHER_COST, 0) + NVL(M.MATERIAL_COST, 0) + NVL(M.FIELD_COST, 0) + NVL(M.FOOD_COST, 0) + NVL(M.STAY_COST, 0) + NVL(M.TRAFFIC_COST, 0) + NVL(M.VISA_COST, 0) + NVL(M.OTHER_COST, 0))
(SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(1) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE COUNT(1) END FROM EDU_FREE_EMPLOYEE F WHERE F.BASIC_NO = M.BASIC_NO AND F.ACTIVITY = '1')

SELECT TO_CHAR(M.COST_NO) AS COST_NO, TO_CHAR(E.BASIC_NO) AS BASIC_NO, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(E.TRAIN_TYPE_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS TRAIN_TYPE_CODE_NAME, E.COURSE_NAME_CODE, TO_CHAR(E.PERIOD_TIME) AS PERIOD_TIME, TO_CHAR(E.IMPLE_START_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS IMPLE_START_DATE, TO_CHAR(E.IMPLE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS IMPLE_END_DATE, TO_CHAR(P.BUDGET) AS BUDGET, TO_CHAR() AS ALL_COST, TO_CHAR(ROUND( / )) AS AVG_COST, AS TOTAL_COUNT, TO_CHAR(M.TEACHER_COST) AS TEACHER_COST, TO_CHAR(M.MATERIAL_COST) AS MATERIAL_COST, TO_CHAR(M.FIELD_COST) AS FIELD_COST, TO_CHAR(M.FOOD_COST) AS FOOD_COST, TO_CHAR(M.STAY_COST) AS STAY_COST, TO_CHAR(M.TRAFFIC_COST) AS TRAFFIC_COST, TO_CHAR(M.VISA_COST) AS VISA_COST, TO_CHAR(M.OTHER_COST) AS OTHER_COST, M.REMARK FROM EDU_COST_MANAGER M JOIN EDU_BASIC_INFORMATION E ON E.BASIC_NO = M.BASIC_NO LEFT JOIN EDU_PLAN_MANAGER P ON P.PLAN_NO = E.PLAN_NO
mapper.select:
WHERE E.ACTIVITY = '1' AND M.ACTIVITY = 1 AND E.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND UPPER(E.COURSE_NAME_CODE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{courseName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) || '%'
AND E.IMPLE_START_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{startDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
AND E.IMPLE_END_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{endDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
ORDER BY E.CREATE_DATE DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE EDU_COST_MANAGER SET TEACHER_COST = #{teacherCost, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, MATERIAL_COST = #{materialCost, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, FIELD_COST = #{fieldCost, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, FOOD_COST = #{foodCost, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, STAY_COST = #{stayCost, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRAFFIC_COST = #{trafficCost, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, VISA_COST = #{visaCost, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, OTHER_COST = #{otherCost, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, REMARK = #{remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_IP = #{adminIP, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE COST_NO = #{costNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
